title: Step 1: Professional Profile Layout with Uploadable Banner & Photo

requirements.text: Add a full-width uploadable banner image at the top of the profile page (ProfilePage.tsx). The banner area should be approximately 180px tall, display the uploaded image as a cover, and fall back to a dark gradient when no image is set. Include a camera icon overlay button on the banner so the user can tap to upload a new banner image. Store the banner image as a blob in the backend (already supported via existing banner blob logic).

quotes: Uploadable Banner — full-width image at the top replacing the black area
banner both by upload actual image

acceptanceCriteria: A wide banner image area is visible at the top of the profile page
A camera/upload icon is shown on the banner that triggers a file input on click
Selecting an image file updates the displayed banner immediately (optimistic preview)
The uploaded banner is saved to the backend and persists across page reloads
When no banner is uploaded, a dark gradient placeholder is shown

requirements.text: Replace the orange initials avatar (AvatarPlaceholder) on ProfilePage.tsx with an uploadable circular profile photo. The profile photo should overlap the bottom edge of the banner (positioned absolutely, bottom -40px from banner bottom, left-aligned with padding). Show a small camera icon overlay on the avatar circle so the user can tap to upload a new profile photo. Store the profile photo blob in the backend. Fall back to the existing gradient initials avatar if no photo is uploaded.

quotes: Uploadable Profile Photo — replaces the orange 'A' avatar
profile and banner both by upload actual image
Profile photo overlapping the banner (Instagram-style layout)

acceptanceCriteria: Profile photo is displayed as a circle overlapping the banner bottom edge
A camera icon overlay on the avatar triggers a file picker on click
Selecting an image updates the avatar preview immediately
The uploaded profile photo persists after page reload
Falls back to gradient initials avatar when no photo is set

requirements.text: Redesign the profile info section below the banner/avatar on ProfilePage.tsx with a professional dark-theme layout: (1) Display the user's display name inside a dark rounded pill/box with a subtle golden glow or drop-shadow. (2) Show the user's @handle in smaller grey text below the name. (3) Show the Followers count inside a dark rounded box with a golden border and golden drop-shadow (existing golden followers box, enhanced). (4) Show Following count as a stat. (5) Show Posts count as a stat. (6) Arrange the stats (Followers, Following, Posts) in a horizontal row beneath the name/handle. Keep the existing Edit Profile button aligned to the right side of the profile header area.

quotes: Name in a styled dark box with golden glow/shadow
Followers count in golden box with shadow effect
shadows in golden box, banner, profile photo, name in box, handle, following

acceptanceCriteria: Display name is shown inside a dark rounded box with a visible golden glow/shadow
@handle is shown in smaller muted text below the name
Followers count is displayed in a golden-bordered box with a golden drop-shadow
Following count and Posts count are displayed as labelled stats in a horizontal row
Edit Profile button is visible and correctly positioned on own profile
Layout is clean, professional, and consistent with the dark golden theme of the app

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui/
Only modify ProfilePage.tsx and any directly related query hooks in useQueries.ts
Do not implement the Edit Profile save flow or Follow system in this step — those are Step 2 and Step 3
Reuse existing backend blob storage endpoints for banner and profile photo uploads
nonGoals: Edit Profile modal with Save button (Step 2)
Follow / Unfollow button and real-time follower count update (Step 3)
Any changes to the feed, explore, or messaging pages
